scope: Static review of the SELinux install-domain re-exec path; not distro binary equivalence or native execution proof
reviewed_behavior: selinux_ensure_install first tests whether the current domain can assign an unknown SELinux label.
When that test fails, bootc copies its current executable, sets the copy's label from the policy label for /usr/bin/ostree, and re-executes the copy.
The observed hosted failure occurred at the fallback copy's fsetxattr(security.selinux), before any bootc switch.

The correction prepares a byte-identical root-owned copy in an explicit install_t service, applies the installed /usr/bin/ostree file label, and then requires exact source/copy hashes and exact file-label equality before use.
The correction does not enable BOOTC_SETENFORCE0_FALLBACK and continues to require enforcing SELinux.
namespace_reason: The switch source, overlay and temporary policy bind exist only in update-o.service's PrivateMounts namespace. Executing the validated fixed copy from that service preserves those exact inputs; a separate mutation service would observe the wrong mount namespace.
pending: A native hosted rerun must prove that executing the install_exec_t-labeled copy transitions as expected under the installed enforcing policy and that status, switch and rollback all complete without a fallback or policy relaxation.
